free_text: The patient is a 60-year-old male with a PSA of 10.0 ng/mL and a biopsy-proven Gleason grade 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2) adenocarcinoma. MRI shows a focal lesion in the right peripheral zone apex with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was identified. Given the patient's chronic kidney disease and mild LUTS, the management assessment focuses on individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
